outlook.title: Well Offshore of Southwestern Mexico
outlook.summary: Showers and thunderstorms associated with a broad area of low pressure located several hundred miles south-southwest of the coast of southwestern Mexico are continuing to become better organized. The environmental conditions are conducive for development, and a tropical depression or tropical storm is expected to form

outlook.title: Central Pacific
outlook.summary: An area of showers and thunderstorms are located well south or southwest of the Hawaiian Islands. Development of this system is becoming less likely as it drifts slowly westward.
